customManagers.description: ARG PHP_VERSION, which build-static.sh would otherwise resolve to the newest 8.5 at build time. php-src tags releases as php-8.5.11.
ARG CADDY_VERSION, which xcaddy would otherwise resolve to the newest Caddy at build time.
ARG CBROTLI_VERSION, which xcaddy would otherwise resolve to the newest plugin at build time.
ARG MERCURE_VERSION, which xcaddy would otherwise resolve to the newest plugin at build time.
ARG VULCAIN_VERSION, which xcaddy would otherwise resolve to the newest plugin at build time.

ARG SPC_COMMIT, the static-php-cli commit the FrankenPHP build runs in place of the nightly spc build-static.sh would download. Its v3 branch has no tags, so git-refs follows the branch head and the commit moves as a digest.

packageRules.description: Subject prefix for the binary's pinned roots, which are build inputs like the builder image the preset already gives build:.

One PR for the builder, Caddy and its plugins. A FrankenPHP release can require a newer Caddy or plugin, and build/pinned-versions.sh fails any build whose binary disagrees with a pin, so moving one without the others goes red.

static-php-cli in a PR of its own, moved at most once a day. Its v3 branch took 1 to 13 commits on each day it moved from September to November 2026, and in the frankenphp group each one restarted the builder's CI from a cold cache. renovate.json sets no schedule of its own because renovate.yml's 18:17 UTC cron is Renovate's only clock, so this window exists for spc alone: 18:00 to 03:59 UTC holds that cron and every start GitHub gave it in the three weeks to 2026-11-10, which came 2.5 to 7.25 hours late, between 20:51 and 01:32, with over two hours to spare. updateNotScheduled is off because Renovate would otherwise still push a newer commit to an open branch outside the window, which is exactly what the runs that merges and CI completions start during the rest of the day would do. A run that starts later still costs spc a day, nothing more. A builder that needs a newer spc fails its CI until this lands.
packageRules.commitBody:
static-php-cli moved the head of its v3 branch, which has no tags, so the pinned commit fell behind it.

Developed-by: Aryan Ameri <github@aryan.ameri.coffee>
Assisted-by: <Renovate:renovate-{{{renovateVersion}}}>

prBodyNotes: The build refuses a binary that carries a file capability: frankenphp-manifest reads the carrier's layers and fails on one. Upstream's own FrankenPHP builds set `cap_net_bind_service=ep`, and a binary with a file capability cannot be exec'd at all under `--cap-drop ALL`.
